data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (状态补语 · Complement of State)

items.py: Zhè liǎng tiān guò de hěn yúkuài.
items.en: These two days were very enjoyable.

items.py: Zhè ge yú zuò de zhēn hǎochī.
Tā shuō Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
items.en: He speaks Chinese very well. (object → repeat verb before 得)

items.py: Wǒ zuò cài zuò de bù hǎo.
items.en: I'm not good at cooking. (negative: 得 + 不 + Adj)

items.py: Tā xiě Hànzì xiě de bù hǎokàn.
items.en: His Chinese characters don't look good.

items.py: Zhè liǎng tiān guò de zěnmeyàng?
items.en: How have these two days been? (question form: 得 + 怎么样)
How is your Chinese study going?

items.zh: A: 你喜欢吃鱼吗？B: 喜欢，这个鱼做得很好吃。
items.py: A: Nǐ xǐhuan chī yú ma? B: Xǐhuan, zhè ge yú zuò de hěn hǎochī.
items.en: (Complement of state) A: Do you like fish? B: Yes, this fish is really delicious.

items.zh: A: 今天的京剧演得怎么样？B: 演得很好。
items.py: A: Jīntiān de jīngjù yǎn de zěnmeyàng? B: Yǎn de hěn hǎo.
items.en: (Complement of state) A: How was today's Peking opera? B: It was performed very well.

items.zh: A: 昨天晚上你几点睡的？B: 十二点。A: 那你睡得很晚。你早上起得也很晚吧？B: 不，我起得很早。
items.py: A: Zuótiān wǎnshang nǐ jǐ diǎn shuì de? B: Shí'èr diǎn. A: Nà nǐ shuì de hěn wǎn. Nǐ zǎoshang qǐ de yě hěn wǎn ba? B: Bù, wǒ qǐ de hěn zǎo.
items.en: (Complement of state) A: What time did you sleep last night? B: 12 o'clock. A: Then you slept very late. You also got up late? B: No, I got up early.

items.zh: 王兰、和子都在语言大学学习，她们是好朋友，像姐姐和妹妹一样。
items.py: Wáng Lán, Hézǐ dōu zài yǔyán dàxué xuéxí, tāmen shì hǎo péngyou, xiàng jiějie hé mèimei yīyàng.
items.en: (Fill in blanks) Wang Lan and Hezi both study at the language university. They're good friends, like sisters.

items.zh: 星期天她们去北海公园玩儿。我给她们照相，照得很多，都照得很好。那天我们玩儿得很高兴。
items.py: Xīngqītiān tāmen qù Běihǎi Gōngyuán wánr. Wǒ gěi tāmen zhào xiàng, zhào de hěn duō, dōu zhào de hěn hǎo. Nà tiān wǒmen wánr de hěn gāoxìng.
items.en: (Fill in blanks) On Sunday they went to Beihai Park. I took photos for them — many of them, all good. We had a great time that day.

items.zh: 你什么时候起床？什么时候去教室？晚上几点睡觉？睡得早不早？
items.py: Nǐ shénme shíhou qǐ chuáng? Shénme shíhou qù jiàoshì? Wǎnshang jǐ diǎn shuì jiào? Shuì de zǎo bù zǎo?
items.en: (Talk about your day) When do you get up? When do you go to the classroom? When do you sleep? Do you sleep early?

items.zh: 在这儿学汉语，你学得怎么样？生活得愉快不愉快？
items.py: Zài zhèr xué Hànyǔ, nǐ xué de zěnmeyàng? Shēnghuó de yúkuài bù yúkuài?
items.en: (Talk about your day) How's your Chinese study? Are you enjoying your life here?

items.zh: 昨天我和几个小朋友去划船了。孩子们很喜欢划船，他们划得很好。我坐在船上高兴极了，也像孩子一样玩儿。这一天过得真有意思！
items.py: Zuótiān wǒ hé jǐ ge xiǎopéngyou qù huá chuán le. Háizimen hěn xǐhuan huá chuán, tāmen huá de hěn hǎo. Wǒ zuò zài chuán shang gāoxìng jí le, yě xiàng háizi yīyàng wánr. Zhè yī tiān guò de zhēn yǒu yìsi!
items.en: (Retelling) Yesterday I went boating with some kids. The children love boating and row very well. I was extremely happy sitting on the boat, playing just like a child. What a wonderful day!
